theorems.name: Submission.areaFormula_chart_jacobian_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N p : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (θ : Rn N → ℝ) (f : Rn N → Rn p) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (u : Rn n), θ (ψ u) ≠ 0 → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (ψ u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap) → (∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w)) → approxTangentPlane n M θ (ψ u) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap ∧ (∃ L : ↥(LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap) →L[ℝ] Rn p, HasTangentialDifferentialAt (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap) f (ψ u) L) ∧ areaJacobian (approxTangentPlane n M θ (ψ u)) f (ψ u) * (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap.normDet = (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u).toLinearMap.normDet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
